7 Days in Switzerland: Zurich & Lucerne Express Itinerary

10 days · Families with children

Switzerland with Kids: 10-Day Family-Friendly Itinerary

10 days · Budget & solo travelers

Switzerland on a Budget: 10-Day Smart Value Route

How to see Zurich, Lucerne, Interlaken, Grindelwald & Jungfrau Region, and Zermatt & The Matterhorn using advance train fares, market lunches, and well-located budget stays.

How to use these itineraries

Each plan assumes you arrive at Zurich (Narita or Haneda) or Interlaken, Grindelwald & Jungfrau Region (Kansai) and uses public transport. Travel days are deliberately light. If you're short on time, cut a base rather than squeezing in more stops — changing hotels costs half a day each time. Use our Rail Pass value helper with your final route to decide whether a rail pass makes sense.
